{{Top|leg}}
A '''claim beacon''', also known as an '''auto beacon''', was used by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] to claim ownership of a new [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The beacon broadcast a continuous signal into the [[Star system/Legends|star system]], and the claim was recognized by members of the [[Brotherhood of Independent Scouts]]. The beacon allowed a scout to protect their claim while heading back to civilization to register their claim.
